notes.title: patch 0.152
notes.notes:
Patch 0.152

Hello there,
This update was primarily focused on creating a small tutorial at the beginning of Zone 1.

According to the feedback, the lack of a tutorial did cause some frustration among new players.
I also reduced the battery consumption
Please let me know what you think!


-reduced battery usage by approximately 30%

-some sfx volume issues were resolved

-added a tutorial at the beginning of zone 1

-corrected a few typos

-a jump counter was added

-fixed other small bugs
